summary.tier_4_note: Tier-4 audit concluded after initial recording: no frozen ManualMapping model exists anywhere in bloc_05 (only §10 'curated manual mapping backed by evidence'); the accepted ratification §10 record names tier 4 as frozen order. Resolution implemented: tier 4 = evidence-backed InstrumentAlias entries of AliasType legacy/display/PROVIDER_INTERNAL_ID semantics WITHOUT ApiSymbol-registration, surfaced as RESOLVED_WITH_WARNING + IDENTITY_MANUAL_OVERRIDE; raw free-form dict mapping remains prohibited.

rows.evidence: bloc_05/01 §9 lists the nine statuses; §9 also names AMBIGUOUS / UNKNOWN_SYMBOL / TERMS_UNVERIFIED / PIT_KNOWLEDGE_BLOCKED as the T1-blocking four. Directive §6 orders implement exactly. RESOLVED_WITH_WARNING is part of the frozen vocabulary; no lifecycle-specific unique status exists for SUSPENDED / DELISTING_ANNOUNCED, so §33 ordering ('use RESOLVED_WITH_WARNING only if justified by plan') governs.
rows.decision: IMPLEMENT exact nine. Resolver semantics: blocking status = no economically usable identity is returned (no winner silently promoted).

rows.evidence: bloc_05/01 §8 lists 'confidence' as an InstrumentAlias field but defines no vocabulary: exact grep over every bloc_05 doc finds no member list. Semantic confidence §13/14 of bloc_05/03 defines a separately-scoped mapping-level vocabulary (different object, higher layer, §14 order) that NEEDS no mention of resolver-side semantics; directive §8 explicitly forbids inventing HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW or scales. The smallest truthful representable value is an opaque validated token carried only as an evidence measurement, never interpreted by the resolver.
rows.decision: CONFIDENCE_REPRESENTATION = OPAQUE_SEMANTIC_TOKEN (validated as a SemanticToken: nonblank, unpadded, verbatim). RESOLVER SEMANTICS DEPEND ON NO THRESHOLD: the matching order is identity-evidence only. No numeric scale and no HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW.

rows.evidence: Same audit as InstrumentAlias.confidence: field named in §9, vocabulary never frozen. The resolver's output confidence is the opaque confidence token of the evidence that produced the decision, carried verbatim, selecting no behavior.
rows.decision: CONFIDENCE_REPRESENTATION = OPAQUE_SEMANTIC_TOKEN propagated from the winning evidence row (matched alias token or the contract instance's own source-evidence token), never a computed score. No threshold anywhere.

rows.decision: REUSE NormalizationQualityFlag; resolver emits only flags with frozen resolver-side semantics: IDENTITY_ALIAS_USED, IDENTITY_LIFECYCLE_BOUNDARY, IDENTITY_SYMBOL_REUSED, IDENTITY_RELISTED, IDENTITY_PROVIDER_ID_MISSING (sibling-evidence wording), IDENTITY_MANUAL_OVERRIDE. Blocking flags AMBIGUOUS-TERMS-UNVERIFIED never emitted silently (directive §28: no fabricated usage).

rows.evidence: Directive §26 orders an audit before code: IdentityResolution.canonical_asset_id (bloc_05/01 §9) is singular while EconomicContract carries four asset refs. bloc_05/07 F1 ('canonical underlying asset') and G1 ordering ('underlying – quote – settlement – margin') make the resolver's meaning unambiguous: the singular field carries the UNDERLYING asset. Examples in §4 (inverse USD contract: underlying=BTC) confirm. No currency-vs-underlying ambiguity remains: §9 wording 'asset identity' plus F1 'canonical underlying asset'.
rows.decision: canonical_asset_id = the EconomicContract.underlying_asset_id of the resolved instance, supplied, never computed. No operator decision remains: F1 is explicit. Disclosure recorded in the implementation evidence file.

tier_4_manual_mapping.finding: No frozen ManualMapping object exists in any bloc_05 doc (checked 01/02/03/04/05/06/07 + both ratifications). bloc_05/01 §10 names the tier 'curated manual mapping backed by evidence' as frozen law. Directive §29 Path A: represent curated manual mapping as evidence-backed InstrumentAlias rows (LEGACY_SYMBOL / DISPLAY_SYMBOL / PROVIDER_INTERNAL_ID alias types that are not native API symbols), each validated with the same PIT law, each carrying evidence refs; IDENTITY_MANUAL_OVERRIDE is an accepted §14 flag.
tier_4_manual_mapping.disclosure: Path A is fully inside the frozen vocabulary (InstrumentAlias + AliasType are explicit frozen objects); no new model is invented and no free-form mapping is admitted. The resolver's tier-4 is therefore implemented as alias-registry scanning, NOT as a separate configurator model. Full disclosures in BLOC_05_I03_IMPLEMENTATION_EVIDENCE.md.

suspended_delisting_announced_resolution.finding: No unique status for SUSPENDED / DELISTING_ANNOUNCED exists in §9's status list. Directive §33: use RESOLVED_WITH_WARNING only if justified by the plan. The plan justify: §5 defines identity resolution as temporal interval matching ('valid_from <= t < valid_to'), and an observation DURING the interval is economically valid no matter what later holds; lifecycle events are evidence, not blockers. So resolution returns RESOLVED_WITH_WARNING + IDENTITY_LIFECYCLE_BOUNDARY iff InstrumentLifecycleEvent evidence places the event-time inside a SUSPENDED / DELISTING_ANNOUNCED window; without such a record it resolves exactly.
suspended_delisting_announced_resolution.disclosure: RESOLVED_WITH_WARNING + IDENTITY_LIFECYCLE_BOUNDARY is the smallest truthful frozen-vocabulary answer; the alternative (secretly refusing identity) would violate §6 rule 4/5 which reserve refusal for PRE-LISTING and post-DELISTING by VALID-TIME.

unknown_state_discovery.finding: UNKNOWN lifecycle (bloc_05/01 §6) is an evidence state, not a resolver result: the seven lifecycle values are what the evidence may SAY. Directive §34's 'fail closed' is implemented by NOT fabricating lifecycle evidence: a lifecycle event list is EVIDENCE-BEARING: no lifecycle record at all plus no ContractInstance activation window => NOT_YET_LISTED remains the only failing answer for a wholly-unreferenced symbol.
unknown_state_discovery.disclosure: No UNKNOWN emission is implemented without evidence.
